tr: Plan bozulana kadar her şey yolunda.
en: Everything goes to plan. Until it doesn't.
Your friends connect to this address:

tr: Host'un gönderdiği adresi yapıştır ya da yaz.
en: Paste or type the address the host sent you.

tr: Herkese aynı. Yönlü: fare / sağ çubuk.
en: Same for all. Directional: your aim.

tr: Port 1024 ile 65535 arasında bir sayı olmalı.
en: Port must be a number between 1024 and 65535.
Enter the address to connect to.

tr: %d portunda oturum açılamadı; port kullanımda olabilir.
en: Could not open a session on port %d; it may be in use.
Could not start a connection to this address.

tr: Bağlantı kurulamadı. Adresi ve portu kontrol et.
en: Could not connect. Check the address and port.
Lost the connection to the host.
The level could not be loaded; the session was closed.

tr: Tailscale yok: yalnız aynı ağda çalışır.

en: {name} is being held! Get them out.

tr: Oyun arkada sürüyor; ekip seni bekliyor olabilir.
en: The game keeps running; your crew may be waiting.
You get away once the whole crew is there.
You weren't at the escape point when the police arrived.

tr: Dükkân sahibi seni tuttu; kimse çekip kurtarmadı.
en: The shopkeeper held you and nobody pulled you free.
You were questioned as a witness and released (you were recognised).
The host starts the next job.

tr: Bakkal bağırdı ama siz çoktan çıkmıştınız.
en: The grocer shouted, but you were already out.
The neighbours were on your heels; the loot sold cheap.

tr: Polis geldiğinde kaçış noktasında olmayan herkes yakalandı.
en: Everyone who wasn't at the escape point when the police arrived was caught.

tr: Kimse yakalanmadı ama dükkândan bir şey alamadınız.
en: Nobody got caught, but you left the shop with nothing.
Spent the least time in sight.
Lingered longest in front of the glass.
Got caught; the crew won't forget it.
Freed a crewmate who was being held.
What are you doing back there?
That one is up to something!
